notes.title: Neither Day nor Night - Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hi folks! Looking for a real challenge?[/b][/h3]

The game is called “Neither Day nor Night” (short: NDnN).

It is an adventure game, a game of skill with a strong emphasis on thinking. 
Even if the player is agile as a monkey, he/she needs to stop and think about how to approach the challenges on his/her way.

At the beginning of the game, atmosphere is idyllic. 
However over time, quite soon, to be honest, Neither Day nor Night is getting gloomy and the plot thickens.

There is no main inspiration for my game. I just wanted to create something that I would like to play, a game that is unique in the independent games market.

The goal of NDnN is to be challenging. 

After each level, the game becomes more difficult. Players learn by making mistakes. Their ability to have better control over the protagonist is increasing over time. The purpose of the game is to bring a joy that the player can feel after overcoming obstacles. I want the player to be proud of his/her persistence. You’ll need that because Neither Day nor Night is filled with challenges. One of the prizes is that you’ll discover a mysterious plot of the game and the end of it that will for sure surprise many gamers.

I'll be hosting a Q&A on Carnotaurus Team Discord Server for a few hours.
Check out the demo and I'm looking forward to hearing from you guys!

Have fun!
[url=https://discord.gg/cg4CcNe]Discord[/url]
